summary: Engine perception+aggro fully mapped from openmohaa-hzm/code/fgame source. The pipeline is: per-actor ActorEnemySet (actorenemy.cpp) accumulates a per-enemy visibility meter via an LMRF time-to-notice formula (sight cone + range + stealthMovementScale + noticeTimeScale), CONFIRMS an enemy at visibility >= 0.999, and computes threat only for confirmed, NON-disguised enemies; a disguised confirmed enemy is deliberately retained as current enemy with threat 0 (the retention clause), which is what routes the actor into THINKSTATE_DISGUISE (papers check) instead of ATTACK. Aggro-vs-disguise is decided by inline Actor::EnemyIsDisguised() (actor.h:2159) which has three escape hatches: enemy not flagged disguised, the ONE-WAY m_bForceAttackPlayer latch, and already-in-ATTACK. The latch is set by the script command 'attackplayer' AND automatically by player-bumps-into-pathing-actor collision branches; it is cleared only in the Actor constructor. Curious is an event-driven state fed by AI sound events (weapon fire/impact, explosion, voices, footsteps, misc) through per-actor hearing/awareness rolls, priority levels 1-9, and a 500ms-after-arrival timeout; actors in any thinkstate other than IDLE/CURIOUS ignore all curious sounds. Scripted anims run as the IDLE-level think THINK_ANIM which still checks all transitions every frame (so aggro interrupts it); its curious variant THINK_ANIM_CURIOUS keeps playing the scripted anim and only head-tracks. ai_off stops Actor::Think entirely (decisions, perception, transitions) while the current anim keeps looping via the Animate system. The HZM coop step2 dynamics (juke/hide) live in actor_turret.cpp/actor_cover.cpp behind coop_aiRetargetMs<5000 gating plus coop_aiJinkMs/coop_aiHideMinMs/MaxMs/coop_aiSuppressChance, and the separate reactive-suppression system (coop_aiSuppress, weaputils.cpp:2325-2344 -> actor.cpp:11017-11036) only degrades aim/forces cover while under fire. Several hardcoded G_GetEntity(0) SP-isms directly affect coop stealth: disguise transition sight-traces client 0's centroid, bump-aggro always confirms client 0, and door/misc AI noise is globally muted only while client 0 is disguised.
key_facts: VISIBILITY METER (actorenemy.cpp:30-126): each ActorEnemy holds m_fVisibility. UpdateLMRF returns 'seconds to fully notice' (LMRF); 8.0 is the CANNOT-SEE sentinel returned when: out of sight range (m_fSight, default world m_fAIVisionDistance, capped at farplane*0.828), behind the actor (2D eye-dir dot), outside FOV cone with a 128-unit close-range bubble where FOV is ignored (line 69-71), CanSee LOS trace fails, or smoke obfuscation >= 1. Otherwise LMRF = Square(enemy->stealthMovementScale * normalizedRangePolynomial) * (dist+128)/facingDot * m_fNoticeTimeScale * g_ai_noticescale (default 1). Visibility accumulates m_fVisibility += frameTime/LMRF while visible; decays at 0.25/sec while not visible BUT ONLY IF < 1.0 (line 113): once visibility reaches 1.0 it is LATCHED FOREVER for that entry until FlagBadEnemy, eviction, or death.

CONFIRMATION: IsEnemyConfirmed() == set's m_fCurrentVisibility > 0.999 (actorenemy.h:141). ATTACK and DISGUISE transitions both require it. m_fTotalVisibility adds GetEnemy()->m_fPlayerSightLevel, which is only ever nonzero on GERMAN actors that the local player CAN SEE (player.cpp:5092-5110 raises it +frametime on observed team-0 sentients) - it makes ALLIED AI confirm player-visible Germans near-instantly and is always 0 for players being looked at by Germans.

THREAT (actorenemy.cpp:128-266 UpdateThreat): returns 0 if enemy->m_bIsDisguised OR totalVisibility < 0.999 OR level.inttime < m_iNextEnemyTime (the 5s reaction cooldown armed by FlagBadEnemy). Otherwise threat = 10000 (+500 if literally on-screen now) + weaponClass-x-rangeZone table + rangeIndex + enemy m_iThreatBias + up-to-500 too-close bonus (inside 1.1*m_fMinDistance) - squadmate-closer discounts - pain discount - attackerCount (cap 4, self-discount 2) +5 recent-enemy hysteresis +5 last-attacker +250 FavoriteEnemy. A DISGUISED player therefore generates ZERO threat even at full visibility.

DISGUISE RETENTION CLAUSE (actorenemy.cpp:469-473): after the threat pass, current enemy is cleared when threat <= 0 UNLESS m_pCurrentEnemy->m_bIsDisguised - a disguised confirmed player stays m_pCurrentEnemy at threat 0. This is the ONLY way a partial/zero-threat enemy survives as current enemy, and it is what lets PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise fire. Consequence: for a NON-disguised player, partial visibility (<0.999) NEVER sets m_Enemy - actors go curious from sight only via the sound/event path or after losing a confirmed enemy.

ENEMY LIST LIFECYCLE (actorenemy.cpp:276-391): AddPotentialEnemy refuses dead and threatbias==THREATBIAS_IGNOREME (0xFFFFE4C7, script 'threatbias ignoreme'); re-adding an existing entry only refreshes m_iAddTime. UpdateEnemyInternal (actor.cpp:6810) re-adds EVERY living opposite-team sentient each pass, so the 10s m_iAddTime expiry (CheckEnemies eviction, actorenemy.cpp:356) in practice only fires when the actor's enemy updates stop running (ai_off, VOID think, RequireThink false) or when the sentient stops being re-addable (IGNOREME/dead - also evicted directly same frame). Other evictions: same team, IsDead, IsDisabled. bug-1631's DISG EVICT instrumentation (g_coopDisgDebug) prints the exact reason for player evictions (actorenemy.cpp:358-380).

FlagBadEnemy (actorenemy.cpp:308-339): zeroes the entry's visibility/threat/visible-state, arms m_iNextEnemyTime = now+5000 (5s immunity to re-confirmation), clears current enemy if it was this one. Called ONLY from attack thinks when the enemy is deemed unreachable/unseeable: actor_cover.cpp:421 (American cover AI with no corner node) and actor_turret.cpp:368/689; always followed by UpdateEnemy(-1) forced re-evaluation.

ConfirmEnemy (actorenemy.cpp:497-522): instantly sets entry visibility 1.0 + lastKnownPos, sets set-level current enemy, and clears pSelf->m_bEnemyIsDisguised - but is a no-op while inside the 5s m_iNextEnemyTime window. Callers: ForceAttackPlayer (client 0), HZM attackentity (actor.cpp:9365, arbitrary sentient, silently ignores dead/non-sentient, does NOT set the latch), NoticeShot enemy-gunfire path (actor.cpp:9733-9736), squad share EventShareEnemy -> ConfirmEnemyIfCanSeeSharerOrEnemy (posted 0.75s after every SetEnemy; requires seeing the sharer unless already visible; suppressed entirely while EnemyIsDisguised(), actor.cpp:9396), and DetectSmokeGrenades (actor.cpp:6853, confirms the OWNER of friendly-team smoke within sight).

UpdateEnemy/SetEnemy (actor.cpp:6810-6915): UpdateEnemy(maxDirtyMs) rate-limits UpdateEnemyInternal (ATTACK checks pass 0 = every frame, CURIOUS/DISGUISE 200ms, IDLE 500ms, script 'getenemy' event 200ms at 12365). Enemy switch: SetEnemy(GetCurrentEnemy()) only when m_bEnemySwitch (default true; script 'enemyswitchdisable'/'enemyswitchenable') or no current enemy - with m_bEnemySwitch true the enemy can also flap to NULL when the set clears. SetEnemy: adjusts m_iAttackerCount, m_bNewEnemy = (had none before), posts ShareEnemy +0.75s, computes m_bEnemyIsDisguised = enemy->m_bHasDisguise && (enemy->m_bIsDisguised || !CanSeeEnemy(0)), stamps m_iEnemyChangeTime. noticeTimeScale recovers +1.0 per 10s toward m_fMaxNoticeTimeScale (script 'noticescale <percent>', 100 = 1.0, actor.cpp:11472).

EnemyIsDisguised() (actor.h:2159-2174) = (m_bEnemyIsDisguised || m_Enemy->m_bIsDisguised) && !m_bForceAttackPlayer && m_ThinkState != THINKSTATE_ATTACK. So: the force latch blinds the actor to disguises permanently, and an actor ALREADY in ATTACK ignores a re-donned disguise. m_bForceAttackPlayer is set in exactly ONE function, ForceAttackPlayer (actor.cpp:9336: ConfirmEnemy(G_GetEntity(0)) + latch), and cleared ONLY in the Actor constructor (actor.cpp:3092) - one-way for the actor's lifetime.

ForceAttackPlayer callers: script 'attackplayer' (EventAttackPlayer, ScriptErrors if no client 0), and TWO physical-collision branches in Actor::GetMoveInfo (actor.cpp:3354-3377 ANIM_MODE_DEST, 3380-3405 ANIM_MODE_PATH/PATH_GOAL): when a moving actor hits a temp obstacle flagged as player (hit_temp_obstacle & 1) and client 0 is not a teammate, it force-enables enemy AI, BecomeTurretGuy() (think map permanently rewritten to turret attack; HZM CoopMannedTurretHold() exempts manned MG42 gunners), and latches ForceAttackPlayer - REGARDLESS of which player did the bumping, and REGARDLESS of disguise. Bumping a pathing actor while disguised = that actor is permanently disguise-blind and aggroed at client 0.

THINKSTATE TRANSITIONS (actor.cpp:8873-8894 CheckForThinkStateTransition, called from within every think function each frame): priority GRENADE > BADPLACE > (if !m_bEnableEnemy: IDLE only) > ATTACK > DISGUISE > CURIOUS > IDLE. CheckForTransition looks up the transition-condition function of the think CURRENTLY MAPPED to that state (m_ThinkMap) - THINK_DISGUISE_NONE registers NO condition (actor_disguise_common.cpp:65-68 sets only IsState), so 'type_disguise none' makes the DISGUISE state unreachable via transitions; but if it is swapped in WHILE the actor is inside THINKSTATE_DISGUISE, the state keeps running with NULL ThinkState/BeginState = actor frozen forever with no transition checks (bug-1631 freeze, engine-confirmed).

PassesTransitionConditions_Attack (8974): UpdateEnemy(0); needs !m_bLockThinkState, m_Enemy, !(FL_NOTARGET), !EnemyIsDisguised(), IsEnemyConfirmed(). _Disguise (9000): !locked, 200ms self-throttle (m_iNextDisguiseTime), m_Enemy, EnemyIsDisguised(), confirmed, |dz| <= 48, 2D dist in (32, m_fMaxDisguiseDist default 256], AND G_SightTrace to G_GetEntity(0)->centroid - HARDCODED CLIENT 0 regardless of who the enemy is (coop bug surface: fails/mis-traces when the disguised player is not client 0). _Curious (9061): m_bIsCurious && !locked && ((no enemy && m_iCuriousTime != 0) || (enemy && !EnemyIsDisguised() && !confirmed)), sets anim hint 6. _Idle (9094): !locked && no enemy && no curious time. _Grenade (8933): m_bIsCurious && !locked && m_bEnableEnemy && m_pGrenade && m_fGrenadeAwareness (default 20%) >= random(). m_bLockThinkState is engine-internal only (entry/flinch anims in curious/turret/cover/weaponless), not script-settable.

CURIOUS LIFECYCLE (actor_curious.cpp): Begin_Curious: DoForceActivate, mood curious, one global voice line per 3s (hint 5 = 'curious_sound', hint 6 = 'curious_sight'), stamps m_iCuriousTime = now, SetLeashHome(origin), paths toward m_vLastEnemyPos clamped to leash (or m_vScriptGoal if set); hints 1-3 play standflinch with think LOCKED; enemy w/ visibility < 0.1 plays 'surprise' locked. Think_Curious: UpdateEnemy(100); on arrival/visible-enemy/DEST-in-FOV-with-LOS (curiousLevel <= 5) or within 48u of goal (level > 5): stand + LookAtCuriosity + TimeOutCurious. TimeOutCurious: NEVER times out while m_Enemy exists and !EnemyIsDisguised(); otherwise exits to IDLE 500ms after the last Begin (each qualifying new sound re-Begins and re-paths). End_Curious zeroes m_iCuriousTime AND m_iCuriousLevel. Suspend (pain/grenade interruption) = End.

AI SOUND EVENTS: broadcast via G_BroadcastAIEvent (g_utils.cpp:1786; script 'aievent'/entity EV_BroadcastAIEvent), radii table (1771): weapon_fire 2048 (weapon.cpp:2166 uses 1500 or clamp(worldRadius/2,1500,8000)), weapon_impact 384, explosion 4096, american/german_voice 1024, urgent 1536, misc 1500, misc_loud 2250, footstep 512, grenade 384, badplace 32768. Reception requires: not the originator, receiver alive+Actor, per-type ignore mask clear (script ignoresounds/etc, actor.h:1795-1849), within radius of centroid, AND area-portal connectivity (areanum equal or AreasConnected). CRITICAL SP-ISM (1798-1804): AI_EVENT_MISC/MISC_LOUD are dropped GLOBALLY while G_GetEntity(0) (client 0) is disguised - doors etc. never alert AI while the HOST is disguised, but a disguised client 2 gets no such muting.

AI EVENT DISPATCH (actor.cpp:9453-9531 DefaultReceiveAIEvent, overridable per-think): same-team non-squadmate originator triggers MergeWithSquad. weapon fire/impact -> WeaponSound if within m_fHearing (default 2048): resolves shot owner; enemy-team shooter + CaresAboutPerfectInfo + NoticeShot -> ConfirmEnemy(owner) + CuriousSound; FRIENDLY shooter clears m_bEnemyIsDisguised (actor.cpp:10041 - squad gunfire breaks disguise belief!) and confirms the shooter's target if path-reachable within 1.5x dist or visible. Voices: enemy-nationality voices always CuriousSound; friendly voices only when vocalist is not a squadmate and not visible (NoticeVoice). Footsteps: only when in IDLE/CURIOUS states, enemy team, NOT disguised (NoticeFootstep 10063: disguised pedestrians NEVER trigger footstep alerts), and not currently visible in FOV. Grenade -> SetGrenade + ShareGrenade. All curious-capable paths funnel into CuriousSound.

CuriousSound (actor.cpp:9607-9673): requires m_bEnableEnemy, m_bIsCurious ('curiouson/off'), and IDLE-level thinkstate currently IDLE or CURIOUS - actors in ATTACK/DISGUISE/PAIN/GRENADE ignore all curious sounds. Hearing roll: rangeFactor (1.0 within ~2/3 of radius, linear falloff to 1/3 at edge... precisely 4/3*(1 - d^2/max^2) capped 1) * m_fSoundAwareness (default 100, script 'sound_awareness') must beat random()*100. RaiseAlertnessForEventType lowers m_fNoticeTimeScale (fire .2, impact .1, explosion .4, enemy voice .25, misc .02, misc_loud/footstep .05, grenade .04, capped at 2/3 of current so it never hits 0; pain adds .5 at actor.cpp:5280). Event priority (grenade 8 > fire 7 > explosion 6 > impact 5 > urgent 4 > voice 3 > footstep/misc_loud 2 > misc 1) must be >= m_iCuriousLevel (pain sets 9 = nothing else can restart it until End_Curious). Then: anim hint (impact<=192u -> 1, fire<=512u -> 2, explosion<=768u -> 3, else 5), SetEnemyPos(sound origin) = investigation destination, EndCurrentThinkState + SetThinkState(CURIOUS).

PAIN AGGRO (actor.cpp:5260-5300): non-teammate attacker -> RaiseAlertness(0.5), m_pLastAttacker (+5 threat), m_iCuriousLevel = 9, hint 7, and (if idle + enemy-enabled + curious-capable) immediate CURIOUS at attacker origin. Note pain does NOT confirm or latch by itself - a disguised shooter stays disguised, but the actor investigates their position.

SCRIPTED ANIMS: script 'anim X'/'animloop X' -> executes global/anim.scr (actor.cpp:5535 PlayAnimation) which issues 'animscript' (EventAnimScript 10890) -> m_csAnimScript, ANIM_MODE_NORMAL, SetThinkIdle(THINK_ANIM); 'anim_scripted' -> global/anim_scripted.scr -> ANIM_MODE_SCRIPTED, 'anim_noclip' -> NOCLIP, 'anim_attached' -> ATTACHED. SetThinkIdle(THINK_ANIM) (actor.cpp:7963-7993) ALSO maps THINKSTATE_CURIOUS to THINK_ANIM_CURIOUS. Think_Anim (actor_anim.cpp:45-69) calls CheckForThinkStateTransition() EVERY FRAME - a scripted anim is interrupted by GRENADE/BADPLACE/ATTACK/DISGUISE transitions (and suspended by PAIN/KILLED think levels). THINK_ANIM_CURIOUS (actor_animcurious.cpp) KEEPS PLAYING m_csAnimScript, only head-tracks (LookAtCuriosity) and TimeOutCurious - curious does NOT visually break a scripted-anim actor. FinishedAnimation_Anim: with no new animscript queued, m_bNoIdleAfterAnim ('noidle 1', actor.cpp:11432) replays the last anim forever, else SetThinkIdle(THINK_IDLE) - the actor drops back to the idle think, which re-picks anims every frame (Think_Idle -> IdleThink -> Anim_Idle = DesiredAnimation(idle.scr)); the scripted anim does NOT resume after combat once it finished.

ai_off/ai_on (SimpleActor::EventAIOff/On, simpleactor.cpp:1209-1217, m_bDoAI): Actor::Think returns immediately (actor.cpp:7716) - no perception, no transitions, no movement decisions, no PostThink; the current animation continues via the Animate system. There is NO 'disable_ai' event in the engine (that is a mod-script alias/convention). Separately m_bEnableEnemy ('enableEnemy 0' via m_bDesiredEnableEnemy + UpdateEnableEnemy actor.cpp:8608): perception stays but the actor is kicked from ATTACK/CURIOUS/DISGUISE to IDLE, SetEnemy(NULL), and only IDLE transitions run; CuriousSound/Footstep/Voice all early-out. Re-enabling sets leash home to current origin (leash-drift trap when toggled far from home). RequireThink (actor.cpp:6794) gates every think on edict->r.lastNetTime + 60s (networked to somebody within the last minute); DoForceActivate (entity.cpp:5617, script 'forceactivate') stamps lastNetTime = now, and Begin_Curious/Turret/Cover/Alarm/Grenade/BadPlace/AnimCurious/Weaponless all call it.

ATTACK ENTRY (actor.cpp:8819-8864 AttackEntryAnimation): global 3s cross-actor throttle; <256u -> chance of 'standshock' surprise anim, >1024u -> 25% 'standidentify' if a squadmate is within 2*m_fInterval; a NEW enemy (m_bNewEnemy: had none before) triggers Anim_Say sighted line. THINK_TURRET is the default attack think (BecomeTurretGuy maps ATTACK->THINK_TURRET, DISGUISE->SALUTE, GRENADE->GRENADE at actor.cpp:13100-13104).

HZM STEP2 DYNAMICS (all in game.dll, cvar-gated, vanilla-identical at defaults): (1) actor_turret.cpp:192-218 Turret_CheckRetarget - vanilla pins repositioning to once per 5s AND 5s after every landed hit (m_iLastHitTime refreshed by the dueling player = the stand-and-shoot mechanism); coop_aiRetargetMs (default 5000 = vanilla, floor 250) tunes the window and ANY value < 5000 also drops the last-hit freeze. (2) actor_turret.cpp:110-190 plant-band squeeze - on the dynamic path, RUN_AWAY/CHARGE thresholds scale by coop_aiRunawayRange/coop_aiChargeRange (defaults 1.0, computed locally, never mutating m_fMin/MaxDistanceSquared, +128u anti-jitter floor). (3) actor_turret.cpp:258-295 JINK in State_Turret_Combat - only the recently-hit (3s) dueled enemy does a lateral STEP_SIDE on its own m_iCoopJinkTime cadence (coop_aiJinkMs, default 0 = OFF, floor 1200ms), self-validating via StrafeToAttack. (4) actor_turret.cpp:427-447 - retarget-suppress short-circuit chance drops from m_iSuppressChance (TIKI default 50) to coop_aiSuppressChance (15) on the dynamic path so retargets actually reposition. (5) actor_cover.cpp:27-53 - German cover hide window rand(4000..15000)ms tunable via coop_aiHideMinMs/MaxMs (floor 250). (6) Reactive suppression: weaputils.cpp:2325-2344 sets actor->m_fSuppressTime = now + coop_aiSuppressTime (1.5s) for enemy-team actors within coop_aiSuppressRadius (150u) of bullet impacts when coop_aiSuppress 1 (default ON); actor.cpp:11017-11036 multiplies aim accuracy by coop_aiSuppressAccuracy (0.2) and (coop_aiSuppressCover 1) can push mobile actors to cover. NONE of these touch perception, visibility, threat, or disguise - they only shape in-combat movement/aim.

DISGUISE THINK CORE (actor_disguise_common.cpp): shared states - WAIT (approach; papers when dist^2*4 < maxDisguiseDist^2; after 3s: >256u away -> back to IDLE, else papers), PAPERS (12s deadline -> ENEMY; player walking >256u away mid-check -> HALT (1.5s then ATTACK); papers 'shown' when actor's m_iEnemyShowPapersTime (stamped at Begin from enemy's m_ShowPapersTime) < enemy->m_ShowPapersTime, which is stamped by USING the papers inventory item, inventoryitem.cpp:83; shown + level.m_iPapersLevel < m_iDisguiseLevel -> DENY (3s then IDLE); accepted -> runs m_DisguiseAcceptThread then ACCEPT (3s -> IDLE + think map downgraded to DISGUISE_SALUTE)), ENEMY (3s of 'enemy' anim then ATTACK unless FL_NOTARGET). After a completed challenge, End of sentry/officer/rover sets m_iNextDisguiseTime = now + m_iDisguisePeriod (default 30000, script 'disguise_period' seconds) - 30s before that actor re-challenges; an aborted one (state 0) re-arms in 500ms. bug-1631 tracer (g_coopDisgDebug 1) prints Begin/End/Suspend/Resume + 2Hz ticks + SetThinkState disguise transitions (actor.cpp:8030-8047).

PLAYER-SIDE INPUTS the actor pipeline reads: Sentient::m_bIsDisguised + m_bHasDisguise (maintained per-frame for every gametype by today's g_coopDisgParity fix in Player::Think - holster=disguised, draw=blown), stealthMovementScale (entity.cpp:5295 'movementstealth', default 1.0, HIGHER = stealthier: multiplies LMRF time-to-notice quadratically; 0 = instantly conspicuous), m_ShowPapersTime (papers item use), m_iThreatBias, m_fPlayerSightLevel (allied-AI sight sharing only), FL_NOTARGET flag (blocks ATTACK transition and disguise-state escalations but NOT threat/visibility accumulation). Footstep AI events broadcast ONLY from anims carrying TAF_AUTOSTEPS|TAF_AUTOSTEPS_RUNNING (sentient.cpp:4119: run anims; walking is AI-silent) at 512u radius, and NoticeFootstep discards them for disguised players anyway.
mechanisms: AGGRO DECISION TREE for a German actor vs a player, in engine order each frame of its think: (1) UpdateEnemyInternal adds all living players to m_PotentialEnemies (unless IGNOREME); (2) round-robin: ONE entry per frame gets UpdateVisibility (the loop continues past entries that are out of fov+range, so with N players it can take up to N frames to touch a hidden one); (3) if visibility crosses 0.999, threat pass runs for ALL entries; disguised players contribute 0 threat but are retained as current enemy; (4) SetEnemy adopts the set's current enemy (subject to m_bEnemySwitch); (5) CheckForThinkStateTransition: ATTACK wins if !EnemyIsDisguised && confirmed; DISGUISE wins if disguised && confirmed && in the 32-256u ring && |dz|<=48 && LOS-to-client-0; CURIOUS if unconfirmed non-disguised enemy or leftover m_iCuriousTime; else IDLE.

STEALTH BUDGET MODEL: time-to-confirm at a given range/angle = LMRF seconds of CONTINUOUS sight; interruptions decay the meter at only 0.25/s (4s from full), so repeated peeks accumulate. All modifiers are multiplicative on time: stealthMovementScale (script-settable per player), per-actor noticescale max (percent), global g_ai_noticescale cvar, transient alertness (RaiseAlertness subtracts up to 2/3 per event, recovers +0.1/s). Below 128u, FOV is irrelevant (the +128 bubble) - point-blank behind-the-back still accumulates.

ONE-WAY LATCH RULE: m_bForceAttackPlayer permanently disables disguise respect for that actor AND ConfirmEnemy targets client 0 specifically. Sources: script 'attackplayer' and engine bump-branches. The HZM 'attackentity' event confirms an arbitrary sentient WITHOUT latching - it is the safe way to hand an actor a target. The mod's bug-1639 rule (never latch a currently-disguised player) is enforceable only script-side; the engine bump-branch latch cannot be script-suppressed short of enableEnemy 0 or noclip/notsolid on the player.

CURIOUS RE-TRIGGER LOOP: every qualifying sound >= current m_iCuriousLevel re-runs Begin_Curious (EndCurrentThinkState + SetThinkState), re-stamping m_iCuriousTime and re-pathing to the newest sound origin; so sustained noise keeps an actor investigating indefinitely, while one isolated noise produces roughly walk-to-spot + 500ms of looking, then IDLE. m_iCuriousLevel only resets on End_Curious, so a high-priority event (grenade 8 / pain 9) blocks lower-priority restarts for the remainder of the episode.

SCRIPTED-SCENE INTERRUPTION MATRIX: THINK_ANIM actor -> curious keeps the anim (ANIM_CURIOUS), attack/disguise/grenade/badplace REPLACE it (anim think stays mapped; if the anim FINISHED before combat ended the map reverts to THINK_IDLE), pain suspends then resumes at Begin (anim restarts from ACTOR_STATE_ANIMATION_INITIAL). ai_off freezes decisions entirely (loops current anim); enableEnemy 0 keeps idle/anim thinks running but blinds combat transitions. m_bLockThinkState (engine-internal, set during flinch/surprise/entry anims) blocks ALL transitions including attack for the anim's duration.

DISGUISE-BLOWN PROPAGATION: an actor that confirms a non-disguised enemy shares it to squadmates 0.75s later (needs LOS to sharer or target); sharing is suppressed while the enemy reads as disguised. Friendly gunfire heard within m_fHearing clears m_bEnemyIsDisguised on listeners (NoticeShot) even without sight. Since EnemyIsDisguised() consults the live player m_bIsDisguised too, clearing m_bEnemyIsDisguised only matters when the player's live flag is also false (weapon drawn) - with g_coopDisgParity the live flag is authoritative per-frame.
constraints_for_designers: Never let scripts call 'attackplayer' (or anything that reaches ForceAttackPlayer) while ANY player is disguised: the latch is irreversible for that actor's lifetime and hard-binds aggro to client 0. Use the HZM 'attackentity <player>' event instead - it confirms without latching and picks the real target.

A disguised player physically blocking a pathing/dest-moving actor triggers the engine bump-branch: permanent latch + BecomeTurretGuy + confirm client 0. Stealth design must keep disguised players out of actor movement lanes or accept permanent blows; there is no cvar gate on this branch today (only the MG42-manned exemption).

PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise sight-traces G_GetEntity(0)->centroid regardless of which player is the disguised enemy - papers challenges against non-host players in coop use the WRONG body for the LOS test (silent misbehavior candidate for multi-player stealth; would need an engine patch mirroring the bug-1638 parity work).

The MISC/MISC_LOUD global mute in G_BroadcastAIEvent keys on client 0's disguise only. In coop, door noise stealth works for the host and silently fails for everyone else - either patch to per-originator/any-disguised semantics or design encounters that don't rely on misc-noise muting.

Threat is zero and ATTACK is impossible while m_bIsDisguised is true - but visibility CONFIRMATION still accumulates and LATCHES at 1.0. The instant a disguise drops (weapon draw), every actor that ever fully saw the player flips to threat 10000+ with no re-notice delay. Plan reveals around this: there is no grace period unless you FlagBadEnemy (5s immunity) or wipe the enemy sets.

Actors only hear curious sounds while their IDLE-level state is IDLE or CURIOUS. Anything you park in DISGUISE/ATTACK (or with a frozen think) is deaf to the entire event system; conversely 'curiousoff' (m_bIsCurious false, engine 2.30 gate) makes an actor deaf to curious AND grenade transitions while leaving attack intact.

'type_disguise none' must NEVER be applied while the actor is inside THINKSTATE_DISGUISE: THINK_DISGUISE_NONE has no think/begin/transition functions, so the actor freezes permanently with no script-visible state (bug-1631). Defer think-map retirement until the disguise think exits (poll thinkstate, or flip after State_Disguise_Accept's 3s window ends).

Footsteps alert AI only from RUNNING anims (TAF_AUTOSTEPS_RUNNING) at 512u, are ignored entirely from disguised players, and are ignored when the actor can already see the walker - walk-speed approaches are AI-silent by engine rule; no need to script footstep muffling.

Do not fight the perception pipeline with per-frame script pokes: visibility, threat, and enemy selection are recomputed inside the engine every think. Durable script levers are: threatbias ignoreme (full unlisting, evicted within 10s), enableEnemy 0 (blind but thinking), ai_off (frozen), movementstealth (time-to-notice multiplier), noticescale (per-actor percent), sight/hearing (radii), curiouson/off, enemyswitchdisable (pin current enemy), FL_NOTARGET (blocks attack transition only - visibility still accumulates and disguise challenges still start; halt/enemy escalation checks FL_NOTARGET too).

The coop step2 dynamics (coop_aiRetargetMs<5000 path, jink, hide windows, suppress chance) shape only in-combat movement and aim; they cannot cause or prevent aggro/disguise decisions - safe to leave enabled during stealth encounters. Reactive suppression (coop_aiSuppress) similarly only reacts to bullet impacts.

RequireThink gates all actor thinks on having been networked within 60s; long-range or PVS-culled setups (sentries armed before players approach) need 'forceactivate' or a curious/attack Begin to guarantee immediate processing.

FlagBadEnemy is the only engine mechanism that UN-confirms a living enemy (visibility wipe + 5s reconfirm immunity) and it is not script-exposed today - exposing it (or an equivalent set-wipe) would be the clean engine hook for a scripted 'lose the player' / grace-period mechanic (RemoveAll exists on the set but is likewise unexposed).
open_questions: ANIM_MODE_SCRIPTED motion semantics (delta-driven origin, collision handling) were not traced in detail - if the stealth plan needs uninterruptible scene anims, verify whether mode SCRIPTED differs from NORMAL in transition behavior beyond movement (the think-side interruption profile is identical).

The bug-1631 ~1.6s m_Enemy oscillation: CheckEnemies eviction reasons are instrumented (DISG EVICT) but this sweep did not identify which eviction condition fires for the papers-checker - the team-equality clause (GetEnemy()->m_Team == pSelf->m_Team) during changeGameType windows is the prime suspect since coop team flips are mod-side; needs the instrumented log to confirm.

Weapon fire broadcast radius has two paths (1500-8000 clamp at weapon.cpp:2166-2172 vs table 2048 vs weaputils projectile paths) - which one covers player hitscan fire in this fork was not pinned down; matters for how far a single unsuppressed shot blows stealth.
m_bSilent (OPM-added, default false) tightens squad-share to a 90-degree FOV check on the sharer; whether any TIKI/script sets it on stock German actors was not checked.

Whether the curious 'm_Enemy && m_iCuriousTime' machinegunner variant (actor_machinegunner.cpp:338 uses OR-precedence differing from PassesTransitionConditions_Curious) is a vanilla quirk worth honoring was not investigated.
